summary: The complete legal domain has at most sixteen decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling distinction among digit-state methods.

replacement_checks.evidence: For each of at most sixteen target digits plus one terminal column, the Accepted implementation visits a constant set of carry/active states and at most 100 ordered digit pairs, giving O(log n) time.

The certificate regression compares every n from 2 through 5000 with direct ordered-pair enumeration, then checks deterministic large values and the maximum boundary against an independently structured recursive digit-state oracle.
